title: Three Sum
description: Given an integer array `nums`, return the number of distinct triplets `[nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]]` such that `i != j != k` and `nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0`.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
hints: Sort the array first to make duplicate elimination easy.
Fix the first number nums[i], then use two pointers on the remainder.
Skip consecutive equal elements to count only unique triplets.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = sorted([int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]])
    cnt = 0
    for i in range(n - 2):
        if i > 0 and nums[i] == nums[i-1]: continue
        l, r = i + 1, n - 1
        while l < r:
            s = nums[i] + nums[l] + nums[r]
            if s == 0:
                cnt += 1
                while l < r and nums[l] == nums[l+1]: l += 1
                while l < r and nums[r] == nums[r-1]: r -= 1
                l += 1; r -= 1
            elif s < 0: l += 1
            else: r -= 1
    print(cnt)
